# Moshe Malka

> Moshe Malka is a New York City software engineer, writing software since 2008, and the founder and principal engineer of the software studio Quentin.Code (quentin.software); he publishes open-source TypeScript packages on npm as moshejs.

He also works on Goldman Sachs' Private Wealth Management portfolio platform. His npm profile lists 30 zero-dependency TypeScript packages, mostly for finance and market math.

This is the official personal site of Moshe Malka, the New York City software engineer. Contact: hello@moshemalka.com.

## Profile

- [Home: Moshe Malka, Founder & principal engineer at Quentin.Code](https://moshemalka.com/): career history, open-source work, Shevirah, and Quentin.Code
- [The Study](https://moshemalka.com/study): a 3D library of 121 books Moshe Malka has read, shelved by subject

## Career

- Goldman Sachs (Sep 2024 – present): frontend on the Private Wealth Management portfolio platform for brokers and high-net-worth clients (React, TypeScript, MobX). Built the reusable Control Bar and Currency Picker used by 12 teams; led the portfolio UX redesign; raised unit-test coverage past 80%.
- Quentin.Code (Feb 2023 – present): founder and principal engineer of his solo studio for AI-first product development, prototypes, and fractional CTO work for early-stage teams.
- Peloton (Mar 2020 – Feb 2023): moved the e-commerce store from React to Next.js and GraphQL; cut checkout from 7 steps to 3; led the Guide product launch; ran the Blockchain/Web3 working group.
- Industrious, formerly CBRE Hana (Apr 2019 – Dec 2019): marketing and operations web; migrated sites from React to Gatsby and GraphQL.
- ICE Bonds, formerly BondPoint (Oct 2018 – Jan 2019): lead frontend on the institutional bond-trading request-for-quote app; built a clipboard CUSIP parser.

## Open source

- [npm profile ~moshejs](https://www.npmjs.com/~moshejs): 30 zero-dependency, MIT-licensed TypeScript packages for rates and Treasury math, options, FX and volatility, market structure, startup equity, and more
- [us-equity-market-calendar](https://www.npmjs.com/package/us-equity-market-calendar): NYSE / NASDAQ trading calendar
- [options-greeks](https://www.npmjs.com/package/options-greeks): Black-Scholes and Black-76 prices, greeks, implied-vol solver
- [benchmyrepo](https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmyrepo): benchmark the coding agents you already have on your own repo's merged PRs
- [options-expiration](https://www.npmjs.com/package/options-expiration): US listed options expiries, including weekly and 0DTE
- [32nds](https://www.npmjs.com/package/32nds): US Treasury price math (32nds quotes such as 105-16+, ticks, basis points)
- [GitHub: moshejs](https://github.com/moshejs)

## Projects

- [Shevirah](https://kelipot.vercel.app/): an interactive web series on Kabbalah by Moshe Malka. Two works (Klippot and the Tree of Life) and fourteen classic texts, 258 teachings, each with its own animated artwork.
- [Quentin.Code](https://www.quentin.software/): AI-first software studio — product development, automation, and legacy modernization led by Moshe Malka. Studio work: https://www.quentin.software/work
